error_reason: The Orchestrator repeatedly failed to execute the core task of extracting the chess position from the image. Despite multiple attempts with different OCR configurations and scripts (Turns 7, 10, 13), the agent failed to successfully obtain the FEN string required for analysis. Instead of persisting until the data was obtained or recognizing the fundamental incompatibility of using text-based OCR on visual chessboard images without a specific chess-piece detector, the agent prematurely terminated the task in Turn 14, explicitly stating that it could not determine the move due to incomplete data. This represents a failure to follow the instruction to determine the optimal move.

suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent attempted to use generic OCR (pytesseract) and basic image processing to identify chess pieces from a high-resolution photo. Generic OCR is ineffective for distinguishing chess piece shapes. The agent should pivot to using a specialized chess board detection library (e.g., `chessgyro`, `chess-detect`, or a custom CNN/YOLO model trained on chess boards) to identify the board coordinates and piece locations, then convert this to a FEN string. If no specialized library is available, the agent should attempt to visually inspect the provided image data (if accessible via the UI) or request a step-by-step logical deduction based on visible piece patterns, rather than persisting in broken OCR loops.

The error type 'fail_task_spec' is appropriate. The confidence is high because the trace clearly shows repeated failure of the OCR approach and failure to transition to a different method.
